rexFleet.text: Rex Fleet — the interstellar military, rescue, survey and corridor-protection service built around Reach and Resolve. Fleet visual grammar is mature deep blue, Ion White and restrained gold, with authority expressed through stewardship, disciplined infrastructure and operational competence.

aegisCrown.text: Aegis Crown — the political and philosophical Crown tradition shaped by protection, convoy defense and the obligation to preserve vulnerable communities through isolation and crisis. This is a Crown tradition, not the name of the ship. RFV Aegis Vigil serves within the wider Fleet while carrying strong Aegis institutional influence.

civilianConvoys.text: Civilian convoy networks — merchant ships, agricultural carriers, passenger vessels, relief craft, local escorts and independent captains whose survival depends on route access, timing, maintenance and trust. They are not Fleet auxiliaries by default and may resist Fleet priorities even while accepting protection.

vergeCivicTraffic.text: Verge civic traffic — locally governed transports, settlements, traders and relief organizations accustomed to unreliable access and long periods of self-reliance. Practical autonomy, food, repair capacity and dignity matter as much as formal security guarantees.
